chapter.verse: En un, sanggam bangin mite pumkhat suakin a tutkhawm ciangin bangzahin hoihin nuam ahi hiam!
Tua in, a puanpi ngawng tunga Aaron’ khamul kaisuk zui-a a taaksuk, a lu tunga sathau manpha tawh kibang hi.
Tua in, Zion mualte tunga a kia Hermon mual pan-a daitui tawh kibang hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in nuntak tawntungna thupha tua mun-ah a pia hi.
